Commit dfcb9f4f99f1 (""sctp: deny peeloff operation on asocs with threads
sleeping on it"") fixed the race between peeloff and wait sndbuf by
checking waitqueue_active(&asoc->wait) in sctp_do_peeloff().
But it actually doesn't work
column2: as even if waitqueue_active returns false

column1: the waiting sndbuf thread may still not yet hold sk lock. After asoc is
peeled off
column2: sk is not asoc->base.sk any more
column3: then to hold the old sk

column1: lock couldn't make assoc safe to access.
This patch is to fix this by changing to hold the new sk lock if sk is
not asoc->base.sk
column3: also set the sk in sctp_sendmsg with the

column1: new sk.
With this fix
column2: there is no more race between peeloff and waitbuf

column1: check 'waitqueue_active' in sctp_do_peeloff can be removed.
Thanks Marcelo and Neil for making this clear.
fix it by changing to lock the new sock instead of adding a flag in asoc.
